method_note: DEGRADED: single-context Impeccable assessment within assigned independent C1 role; no nested agents because coordinator explicitly prohibited spawning. This is bounded C1 conformance review, not a complete Impeccable critique or user acceptance.

actual_use_details.I: Read actual Impeccable skill and critique reference. Ran context.mjs --target index.html once from the repair directory. Independently inspected source originals and all supplied after screenshots before running detect.mjs --json index.html. Applied brief-wins/refinement-preserves and hierarchy/grouping criteria. Detector ran in degraded regex mode because HTML parser modules were unavailable; its single Arial warning is outside approved local spacing scope.
actual_use_details.U: Read actual UI UX Pro Max skill and quick-reference. Executed search.py "responsive horizontal overflow mobile" --domain ux. Top match Responsive/Horizontal Scroll/Web is applicable; table result not applicable. Compared source CSS and complete narrow/wide captures, independently measured overflow and control sizes; preserved project-specific spacing rather than generic defaults.
actual_use_details.V: Read actual web-design-guidelines skill, fetched fresh official command.md via web and saved its exact downloaded bytes. Reviewed applicable semantic-button, keyboard/focus, feedback, content handling and interaction rules against source and independent Edge run. No full-site accessibility certification.
